gallery.p_text.im_from_madrid_but_marrie: “I’m from Madrid but married a Catalan woman in Barcelona. Three languages at our wedding — Spanish, Catalan, and English for her sister’s family. WeddingAI dubbed the vows and speeches in all three. My abuela finally heard our vows in her dialect.”
gallery.p_text.italian_ceremony_hindu_tr: Italian ceremony, Hindu traditions, and English vows — we subtitled the entire film in both Hindi and English. Family in India felt fully included for the first time.
gallery.p_text.look_closely_at_the_befor: Look closely at the before-and-after pairs in the second section. The VHS footage wasn't just digitized — it was upscaled to HD, color-corrected to match modern cameras, and the audio was denoised and EQ'd. That's the level of care every project receives, whether it's a 1987 wedding tape or last weekend's ceremony.
gallery.p_text.mom_passed_two_months_bef: Mom passed two months before the wedding. Her 1985 wedding photo was AI-activated to blink, smile, and look toward the camera. Played at the reception during a quiet moment.
gallery.p_text.my_dad_is_in_the_uk_and_c: “My dad is in the UK and couldn’t fly to our wedding in Tuscany. He recorded a heartfelt video message and WeddingAI integrated it into the ceremony at the exact moment we’d reserved his seat. He felt like he was there.”
gallery.p_text.my_grandfather_passed_yea: “My grandfather passed years before I met my husband. My dad cried for the first time since Grandpa’s funeral.”

gallery.p_text.we_commissioned_custom_we: “We commissioned custom wedding memes for our reception slideshow and they absolutely broke the dance floor. Our grandparents didn’t get the references but everyone under 40 was in tears laughing. 10/10 would meme again.”
